action: Replaced the homepage hero and moved the trust band up the page

was.copy: Discover useful toys, travel gear, feeding essentials and smart products selected to make life better for dogs and their owners.
was.source: wp:cover block with inline styles in post_content
was.problem: Both sentences would sit unchanged on any pet site. Neither said what this site does differently.

now.h1: Dog gear, with the drawbacks written down
now.copy: Toys, beds, travel kit, feeding gear, grooming tools and trackers, with a buying guide behind each one. Every listing says what the product does badly as well as what it does well - including when that costs us the sale.
now.trust_line: 167 products / nothing under 80% seller feedback, lowest is 85.1% / drawbacks written on every listing / we say where the commission comes from

hero.live_data: Product count and feedback floor are read at render via lookdog_rating_floor(), so the copy cannot drift from the catalogue

design.scrim: Flat black at 55% replaced with a navy gradient. Black is not in the palette; the gradient keeps the left legible and lets the photograph survive on the right.
design.buttons: 30px pill, which the design reserves for photographic grounds
design.trust_line_shape: One sentence, not stat columns - [lookdog_method] lower down already uses big-number columns and the brief forbids repeating a layout family
design.check_design: Passed with no violations against lookdog-navy-ember

section_order.why: The 'How things get on this site' band is the strongest reason to trust the rest of the page and it was last, below everything - where a site puts what it does not really mean.

refactor.lookdog_rating_floor: Moved out of lookdog-home-guide.php into lookdog-product-facts.php, which owns the _lookdog_rate meta it reads. Both the hero and the method band call it.

verification.method: wp_remote_get() from inside WordPress. lookdog.club is not reachable from the dev environment - the egress policy answers 403 to CONNECT lookdog.club:443 - so no screenshot was taken.
checked: exactly one <h1>, reading 'Dog gear, with the drawbacks written down'
old headline absent from the page
trust line renders with live numbers
hero image carries real alt text
section order in the body: hero, rail, categories, method, featured guide, guides index
verification.caveat: Section order was first checked with a regex that matched class names in the stylesheet rather than in the markup, which proves nothing. Re-checked against the body only.
